protocol.classification: Retrospective standard-baseline addition on completed native outcomes. Training and selection use the original development split.
protocol.purpose: Compare a trainable text representation with the existing frozen-encoder value heads and numerical forecast corrections.
protocol.scope: Initial checkpoint, DeepSeek Flash actor, 120 development and 400 test questions. At this checkpoint the varying public state is the question; source assistant/tool histories are empty. The actor, tools and budgets are fixed.

encoder.input: Question text only. IDs, split, task stratum, references and outcomes stay outside the encoder input.
encoder.pooling: Attention-masked mean followed by L2 normalization.

targets.probabilities: Two sigmoid outputs, squared error against the two four-draw development success rates.
targets.gain: One tanh output, squared error against SEARCH minus THINK development success rates.

training.head_initialization: Zero weights and inverse-link bias at the training-fold mean.
training.folds: Four stratum-balanced development folds; supporting pages are already disjoint among development questions.

protocol.selection: For each target choose learning rate and epoch by pooled held-out development squared error. Report that neural model even when the constant is competitive. A separate guarded row chooses the neural model only when its CV loss is below the fold-trained constant. Ties select the constant.
protocol.analysis: Freeze all test predictions before scoring. Compare with raw, constant and affine forecasts under four endpoints, source-supported sensitivity and component bootstrap. Report all fixed methods. Saved-branch routing uses development mean extra actor tokens and reports CPU inference separately from API-token utility.
protocol.resources: Cached encoder, CPU training and inference. Zero new model API calls, search calls or actor outcomes. Do not alter the active Qwen actor campaign.
protocol.engineering_revision: The earlier development-only pilot retained an encoder-scale head learning rate and nearly constant outputs. V2 uses a separate 0.001 head learning rate; the earlier protocol, code and CV predictions are preserved. No earlier test predictions or scores were produced.
protocol.boundary: This is a standard trainable-value baseline, not a reproduction of an entire published stopping system. Existing test outcomes were known before this extension; any favorable new selection requires independent confirmation.

fit.classification: Retrospective standard-baseline addition on completed native outcomes. Training and selection use the original development split.
fit.time_measurement: Wall time on CPU, including selection, fitting and final inference. CPU service time is not measured.

scope: Retrospective trainable-value comparison on the original four-hundred-question Flash initial-checkpoint frame. Preserve shared source outcomes and support-component identities.
